name: io.github.walma-labs/google-ads-mcp
description: Read-only Google Ads MCP server with service-account auth: GAQL search, field metadata and accessible accounts.

environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_ADS_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Path to the Google service-account JSON key (or set GOOGLE_ADS_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON with the key inline)

environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_ADS_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON
environmentVariables.description: The service-account key as inline JSON (alternative to the file path)

environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_ADS_DEVELOPER_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Google Ads API developer token, from the API Center of a manager account

environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_ADS_LOGIN_CUSTOMER_ID
environmentVariables.description: Manager account to act through, when the service account reaches the ad accounts via a manager
